name: QuestFiles VR File Manager
summary:
Your headset finally has a real file manager.

CONNECT TO EVERYTHING
- Network: SMB (Windows shares, NAS), FTP, SFTP and WebDAV. Saved connections reconnect with one tap.
- Cloud: Google Drive and Dropbox. Browse, download and upload like any other folder.
- USB: external drives over USB-C, including NTFS disks Android normally refuses to read.
- Local: everything on the headset, including your captures and recordings.

NO CABLE NEEDED
